messages.subject: different width in barplot
parts:
Hi,
 
 
I need a barplot with different size of bars on each x axes, I found a code like the below that makes each bar different in size, but I cannot use the position = “fill” because the width has to be similar.
Is there a way around this, width has to be proportionate to “a” and I have to fill each bar with factor “c”.
 
A1 <- data.frame(a = c(rep("a",2),rep("b",2)), c = LETTERS[4:7],
                d = as.numeric(c(10,23,55,66)), e = as.numeric(c(rep("21.5",2), rep("78.5",2))))
 
               
ggplot(a1, aes(x=a, y=d, width=e/100)) + 
  geom_bar(aes(fill=a), stat="identity", position="identity")
 
Regards
Serdar Akin
